description: Team capacity planner (sprint/period hours) — Team capacity for a date range: working days (Mon-Fri minus US federal holidays, holidays=none to skip), per-person available days after PTO, allocation %, focus factor (default 0.7), hours/day (default 8). team='name:allocation%:ptoDays[:hoursPerDay]' separated by ';'. Optional demandHours= gives utilization, OVER CAPACITY / AT RISK / OK / UNDER-USED verdict, extra FTE or days needed; velocityPerPersonDay= adds story points. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_capacity_plan
